column1: # Deinflection rules for the rule-table lemmatizer (RuleLemmatizer).
# Columns (tab-separated): in, out, types_in, types_out, reasons
#   in / out   suffix replaced (in -> out); "-" means the empty string
#   types_in   word types the current form must have for the rule to apply. "-" = only on
#              the raw input. The raw input counts as every final type and the intermediate
#   types_out  word types of the result. Final types are checked against JMdict parts of
#              speech by LemmaValidator; te/ta/stem/mizen are intermediate only.
#   reasons    inflection labels (string resources lemma_reason_<key>), "-" for none
# Types: v1 (ichidan), v5 (godan, sub-type from the last kana), v5k-s (行く), v5u-s (問う, 請う),
#        vk (来る), vs (する verbs and suru nouns), adj-i, adj-na,
#        te (て/で form), ta (た/だ form), stem (連用形), mizen (未然形)
# @raw <type> <reason> lines list the intermediate types the typed word itself can be, with
# the label shown when a rule reads it that way (読み -> 読む is a 連用形). A bare 未然形
# (読ま) is never a word on its own, so mizen is not listed.
# Lines starting with @prefix name an honorific prefix (お読みになる): the input is also
# lemmatized without it, keeping only results that undid an honorific ending.
# Every new edge case needs a rule here and a line in src/test/resources/lemma_cases.tsv.
